summary: The system is experiencing a normal traffic spike generated by the load-generator service, resulting in increased request rates on frontend-proxy and image-provider without any application errors or resource starvation.
symptoms: Increased request rate on frontend-proxy (12.532 rps vs baseline 3.868)
Increased request rate on image-provider (3.495 rps vs baseline 0.751)

root_cause.description: An expected increase in simulated user traffic from the load-generator has elevated request rates across frontend-proxy and image-provider above their previous baselines.

evidence.explanation: get_service_overview reports a traffic spike on frontend-proxy and image-provider compared to baseline
get_service_overview shows image-provider also experiencing a traffic spike
get_container_health confirms the load-generator container is running normally with zero restarts and healthy status

ruled_out: Application errors or failures (error rate is 0.0 across services)
Crash loops or resource exhaustion (containers are healthy or running normally with no OOM kills)

proposed_action.expected_outcome: Request rates on frontend-proxy and image-provider return to baseline levels as simulated traffic is reduced.
proposed_action.reason: Traffic spike caused by the load-generator service has elevated request rates across frontend-proxy and image-provider; throttling the load generator will alleviate this load.

prevention: Ensure load generation configurations and traffic scaling policies are properly calibrated during testing or baseline comparisons.
